about: Recorded by scripts/demo/real-run.mjs: every request below went through the real Reins pipeline (MCP request_purchase, hard rules, a real Claude audit) on the real PayPal sandbox in treasury mode (Payouts API, paid to a sandbox personal account whose address is not stored here). Ids, amounts, decisions, auditor text, model, tokens, latency and times are as recorded. Nobody approved anything: requests sent to a human are still pending. scripts/seed.ts replays this file and shifts every time by one offset so the run ends just before the demo boots.
